target_customer: Engineering and security teams at software companies that need to find and fix vulnerable dependencies quickly
problem: Security scanners flood teams with vulnerability alerts and dependency updates need manual review. EdgeBit automated analysis of dependency updates and prioritised what was actually running in production.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for software composition analysis and dependency autofix
product_category: Software supply chain security and dependency management

founders.name: Rob Szumski
previous_startups: CoreOS (YC S13, early employee, acquired by Red Hat in 2018)
founders.background_notes: Product leader; became Director of Product at Red Hat after the CoreOS acquisition.

founders.name: Eugene Yakubovich
founders.background_notes: Designed foundational layers for high-frequency trading and contributed to container runtimes.

founders.name: Russell Haering
founders.background_notes: Listed as CTO in the YC launch post but not among active founders on the profile.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mapping vulnerabilities to running workloads, generating SBOMs across containers and Linux, and analyzing dependency updates with static analysis is standard security engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Reachability and SCA were a crowded category and features were copyable, with modest lock-in from integrations into CI and runtime environments.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: FOSSA, a software composition analysis vendor, acquired EdgeBit in 2025 to add dependency autofix.

market_need_then: Software supply chain attacks and SBOM requirements pushed security teams toward dependency visibility around 2022 and 2023, and alert fatigue from scanners was a common complaint.

identity.logo: EdgeBit wordmark logo with a dark-background inverted version
identity.voice_and_tone: Action oriented, with the tagline Security Vulnerabilities Found, Fixed and Merged, Continuously

branding.brand_signature: The found, fixed and merged tagline framing the product as a fixer rather than a reporter

brand_strength.rationale: A clear product tagline on the company site but no press, community or merch about the brand found, and the name resembles many other Edge brands.

outcome_analysis: EdgeBit was a five person team led by CoreOS and ScaleFT alumni selling dependency autofix and runtime aware SCA. It raised only a small round per aggregators and was acquired by FOSSA, announced in September 2025, with YC listing July 2025. Terms were not disclosed. It looks like a strategic tuck-in by a vendor wanting the technology and team rather than a scaled outcome.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, FundedIQ) show a $500K pre-seed in April 2023 from Y Combinator and Liquid 2 Ventures; unverified, so no round is recorded.
